test_title: PYST 73: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, G, H, I, Q, R and S, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. I sits to the immediate right of S. Only three people sit between I and Q when counted from the left of I. R sits to the immediate right of H. How many people sit between G and H when counted from the left of H?
solution:
Given: S, I, Q, H, R and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

I sits to the immediate right of S.

Only three people sit between I and Q when counted from the left of I.

R sits to the immediate right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/436c63f1f7029918c7b24cfd804751b514696ca89c4f757c9c2094175600a5f0.png] 

So, there is 1 person between G and H from the left of H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
